commands.summary: Build passed with 0 errors and 6 NU1900 NuGet vulnerability feed warnings.

lint.summary: dotnet format is optional and non-blocking only with an explicit timeout; it was not run for this verification.

frontend.summary: git diff and untracked file checks show no frontend files changed for task-010; npm build is not required.

acceptance.criterion: TCP client can establish a connection.
acceptance.evidence: TcpDoipServerTests.LocalTcpClientCompletesRoutingActivationAndAliveCheck connects a local TcpClient to the server.

acceptance.criterion: Allowed tester logical source address can complete Routing Activation.
acceptance.evidence: TcpDoipServerTests.LocalTcpClientCompletesRoutingActivationAndAliveCheck verifies SuccessfullyActivated response and registry activation.

acceptance.criterion: Non-whitelisted tester logical source address Routing Activation fails.
acceptance.evidence: TcpDoipServerTests.NonWhitelistedSourceAddressReceivesDeniedActivation verifies DeniedUnknownSourceAddress and no activated registry entry.
TcpDoipServerTests.StreamReaderBuffersHalfFrameUntilComplete verifies partial data is buffered until the complete frame arrives.

acceptance.criterion: TCP sticky/continuous frames produce multiple frames correctly.
acceptance.evidence: TcpDoipServerTests.StreamReaderReturnsMultipleFramesFromSingleBuffer verifies Routing Activation and Alive Check frames from one buffer.

acceptance.criterion: Disconnect removes connection state from registry or marks it disconnected.
acceptance.evidence: TcpDoipServerTests.DisconnectRemovesConnectionFromRegistryAndPublishesEvent waits until active snapshots are empty and checks disconnect event.

acceptance.criterion: Connection created, disconnected, and timeout events enter the existing structured log and Web log UI pipeline.
acceptance.evidence: TcpDoipServer publishes RuntimeEventCategory.Doip events through RuntimeEventBus; TcpDoipServerTests cover created, disconnected, and timeout event names.

acceptance.criterion: Alive Check Request receives a basic response.

scope_check.item: No new UDP behavior beyond existing DoIP UDP vehicle discovery implemented.
No diagnostic forwarding or UDS service handler implemented.
No new Web UI page, complex chart, or connection management editing UI added.
No PCAP, external observability integration, or security audit report implemented.

warnings: dotnet build/test emitted NU1900 warnings because NuGet vulnerability feed data could not be fetched; this is non-blocking and did not affect build or test success.
